[[File:Spade detail.png|left|120px]]
A '''spade''' is a multi-functional tool used for a variety of activities. One of its major uses is in the [[Farming]] skill, though it also comes in handy for many [[quests]] and [[Treasure Trails]]. A spade is also needed to enter the [[Barrows]] crypts and the [[Mole Hole]].

Spades are sold in [[farming shop]]s and many [[general store]]s, and an infinite supply can be added to the [[player-owned house]] by making a [[tool store 2]]. They can also be obtained from a [[rogue kit]], or taken from [[Spade (scenery)|scenery objects]] found in various places. Finally, players can ask [[Konoo]] at the saltpetre mine in [[Hosidius]] for a spare spade.

==Uses==
===Quests===
*[[Olaf's Quest]]: 1x Spade to dig into [[Brine Rat Cavern]]
*[[Ernest the Chicken]]: 1 × spade to search [[compost heap]]
*[[Fishing Contest]]: 1 × spade to collect [[red vine worm]]
*[[Ghosts Ahoy]]: 1 x spade to dig on the island
*[[Pirate's Treasure]]: 1 × spade to unearth [[Casket (Pirate's Treasure)|One-Eyed Hector's chest]]
*[[Plague City]]: 1 × spade to dig [[Dug hole#mud patch|mud patch]]
*[[X Marks the Spot]]:  1 × spade to find clues and treasure
